snippet.title: Arkheron developer interview & Spires breakdown - PC Gaming Show 2026
snippet.description:
The Only Way Out is Up. Join the team at Bonfire Studios as they break down the fast paced gameplay, narrative design, and newest game mode that await players in Arkheron. 

Sign up for the playtest and play the new Spires mode on Steam.
